mapper.select:
select sn.id, sn.order_id, sn.sn_no, sn.carton_no, sn.create_by, sn.create_time, sn.update_by, sn.update_time, o.order_no, o.pn, o.po_me_no, o.pi_me_no from crm_sales_order_sn sn inner join crm_sales_order o on o.id = sn.order_id
and sn.order_id = #{orderId} and o.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') and o.pn like concat('%', #{pn}, '%') and sn.sn_no like concat('%', #{snNo}, '%')
order by sn.id desc
mapper.insert:
insert ignore into crm_sales_order_sn(order_id, sn_no, carton_no, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.snNo}, #{item.cartonNo}, #{item.createBy}, now(), #{item.updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update crm_sales_order_sn set sn_no = #{snNo}, carton_no = #{cartonNo}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from crm_sales_order_sn where id in #{id}
delete from crm_sales_order_sn where order_id in #{id}
